metadata.title: Why Nvidia Stock’s Losing Streak Is a Good Thing Ahead of Earnings<!-- --> - Barron's

content.text:
Why Nvidia Stock’s Losing Streak Is a Good Thing
Nvidia shareholders don’t look to be particularly excited about its coming earnings report. That could be just what the chip maker needs to finally get some momentum.
